content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no parameters). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No arguments. Probably uses sample at hand. So we can call it.
